description: extract_text onStreamError (pdfnative 1.9.0 through pdfnative-mcp 1.8.0): a content stream over the decompression cap (PDFNATIVE_MCP_MAX_INFLATE_BYTES) fails the call with PDF_PARSE_FAILED by default ('limit'), naming the operator remedy; 'skip' reads the rest of the document and the capped page comes back empty — the 1.7.0 behaviour, one opt-in away. On a document under the cap, as here, both policies return the same text; the example shows the input shape.

blocks.text: FlateDecode page content, read back with the stream policy made explicit.
